args: msg=""; for m in "${MST_BIN:-}" "$(command -v mst 2>/dev/null)" "$HOME/.local/bin/mst"; do if [ -n "$m" ] && [ -x "$m" ]; then "$m" mcp --help >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec "$m" mcp; msg="mstep: the mstep MCP server runs through the mst CLI, and $m is too old for it (mst mcp). Update it: curl -fsSL https://fab.moltavista.com/install.sh | sh (then restart Codex)"; fi; done; [ -n "$msg" ] || msg='mstep: the mstep MCP server runs through the mst CLI, which is not installed. Install it: curl -fsSL https://fab.moltavista.com/install.sh | sh && mst login (then restart Codex)'; echo "$msg" >&2; while IFS= read -r l; do id=$(printf %s "$l" | sed -nE 's/^[{] *"jsonrpc" *: *"2.0" *, *"id" *: *([0-9]+|"[^"]*").*/\1/p; s/.*"method" *: *"initialize".*"id" *: *([0-9]+|"[^"]*").*/\1/p' | head -n 1); if [ -n "$id" ]; then printf '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":%s,"error":{"code":-32000,"message":"%s"}}\n' "$id" "$msg"; fi; done
